en.title: How to File a DNCRP Consumer Complaint
en.directAnswer: Use the official DNCRP complaint channel and keep proof of the purchase or service. DNCRP currently publishes hotline 16121 and complaint information. The exact filing deadline and required evidence should be re-checked from the official site before every update.

atAGlance.whoFor: A citizen wants the official consumer complaint steps.
atAGlance.legalBasis: Consumers’ Right Protection Act, 2009; DNCRP official complaint process.
atAGlance.mainRule: DNCRP’s official guidance asks for a written complaint and relevant purchase receipt/evidence.
atAGlance.updateStatus: DYNAMIC PROCEDURE: verify hotline, portal, deadline and evidence rules on the publication date.

en.lawMeaning: DNCRP’s official guidance asks for a written complaint and relevant purchase receipt/evidence. This page gives a general route. A person’s exact rights can change because of facts, documents, deadlines, legal status, court orders or later amendments.
evidence: Receipt; invoice; payment proof; product/service evidence; ad; chats; seller details.
en.simpleExample: A buyer writes: what was purchased, date, price, problem, seller response and requested remedy. A short factual complaint is more useful than an emotional story with no receipt.
commonMistakes: Common mistakes: filing against the wrong business.
Common mistakes: using unofficial social-media inbox as the only complaint..

whatIf.question: What if there is no receipt?
whatIf.answer: Check whether other evidence is accepted.

whatIf.question: What if the seller is online?
What if the complaint is rejected?
whatIf.answer: Ask for the reason and other lawful routes.

en.specialistTrigger: Injury; criminal fraud; very high-value loss; cross-border seller; limitation issue.
